title: Compatible objectwise isomorphisms for the discrete representation construction
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-exc-discrete-continuous-rep-commgrp, the elementwise construction yields an equivalence E and chosen isomorphisms e_X between the two underlying action functors, such that every equivariant morphism f satisfies F.map f ≫ e_Y = e_X ≫ G.map f.

proof.text: Construct the reverse functor H from discrete continuous integer representations to internal commutative groups using the represented presheaf of equivariant functions. Its action on carriers and morphisms is the original one. Faithfulness follows by equality of underlying functions.
Use fullness and essential surjectivity to make H an equivalence; take its inverse equivalence E.

Whisker the counit of H.asEquivalence with the internal-group forgetful functor and the inclusion into plain actions. Because H retains the underlying action definitionally, its components have exactly the requested carrier types. Naturality of the whiskered counit supplies every compatibility square.

proof_origin.note: Explicit reverse functor and counit assembly of the source identification.

theorem discreteContinuousRep_equiv_with_compatible_objectwise_iso
    (G : Type u) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CartesianMonoidalCategory (DiscreteContAction (Type w) G)]
    [BraidedCategory (DiscreteContAction (Type w) G)] :
    let D := DiscreteContinuousRep.{0, u, w} ℤ G
    let U : D ⥤ Rep.{w} ℤ G := ObjectProperty.ι _
    let V := ObjectProperty.ι (ContAction.IsDiscrete (V := Type w) (G := G)) ⋙
      ObjectProperty.ι (Action.IsContinuous (V := Type w) (G := G))
    ∃ E : CommGrp (DiscreteContAction (Type w) G) ≌ D,
      ∃ e : ∀ X, (E.functor ⋙ U ⋙ RepToAction ℤ G ⋙
        (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{w} ℤ)).mapAction G).obj X ≅
          (CommGrp.forget (DiscreteContAction (Type w) G) ⋙ V).obj X,
      ∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y),
        ((E.functor ⋙ U ⋙ RepToAction ℤ G ⋙
          (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{w} ℤ)).mapAction G).map f) ≫
            (e Y).hom = (e X).hom ≫
              ((CommGrp.forget (DiscreteContAction (Type w) G) ⋙ V).map f)
